verdict.rationale: A government IP office could plausibly publish an API with a sandbox or test environment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only human web and paper filing, search pages, and a robots.txt probe of the search host; nothing documents a machine channel or any sandbox or test environment for exercising one end to end.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
